questions.text: Define Earned Value Management (EVM). Explain Planned Value (PV), Earned Value (EV), and Actual Cost (AC). Calculate Cost Variance (CV), Schedule Variance (SV), Cost Performance Index (CPI), and Schedule Performance Index (SPI), and interpret the performance status of the project from given cost and progress data.

Given the activity list, precedence relationships, and durations for a project: (a) Draw the network diagram. (b) Determine Earliest Start (ES), Earliest Finish (EF), Latest Start (LS), Latest Finish (LF), and Total Float (TF) for each activity. (c) Identify the critical path and compute the total project duration.
What is Work Breakdown Structure (WBS)? How does WBS affect the work estimate of the project? Construct a WBS up to level 3 for an ICT software project.
What are the typical stages of Project Life Cycle, as per PMI? How does a project life cycle differ from a product life cycle?
What is system view of project management? Explain about the three-sphere model of systems management (Business, Organization, Technology) with suitable examples.
Describe different types of organizational structures (Functional, Projectized, and Matrix). What are the advantages and disadvantages of Matrix organization structure in ICT project execution?
Differentiate between Project, Program, and Portfolio Management. Discuss briefly the drivers for making project portfolio management decisions.
Define Project Management Office (PMO). What are the major reasons for the success and failure of ICT projects?
What is Project Risk Management? Explain risk identification techniques. Differentiate between Qualitative and Quantitative Risk Analysis, and explain risk response strategies.
Why is Communication Management important in IT projects? As a project manager, how do you handle communication among distributed teams? Calculate communication channels using $C = \frac{N(N-1)}{2}$.
What is Project Integration Management? What type of information should be included while developing a Project Charter? Explain the Integrated Change Control process.
What are the essential interpersonal and managerial skills required to be a successful Project Manager? Discuss key roles and responsibilities of project team members.
What is System Development Methodology? Compare traditional predictive Waterfall methodologies with Agile / Scrum frameworks for software development.

Explain schedule compression techniques: Crashing versus Fast-Tracking. Define cost slope: $\text{Cost Slope} = \frac{\text{Crash Cost} - \text{Normal Cost}}{\text{Normal Time} - \text{Crash Time}}$ and explain how optimal project compression is achieved.
Write short notes on: (a) Balanced Scorecard (BSC), (b) Role of Feasibility Study, (c) RACI Matrix, (d) Project Closeout.
Define project. Differentiate between project and operation. Explain the Project Management Triple Constraints (Scope, Time, Cost) and discuss how they affect project delivery.
